title: Chief of Staff — Morning Flash (Thu)
content:
Morning flash — quick capture (Thu)
Date: 2026-03-13

Energy: 6/10 (slept late; coffee two cups)
Focus window: 09:00–11:30 (deep work) then buffer for meetings 13:00–17:00

Top immediate priorities (do not push):
1) Dedicated rollout: confirm SLA language for West-2 pilot — need legal sign-off before EOD. If not, escalate to Marisa.
2) Private VPC pilot onboarding: unblock customer A’s network peering step — Evan to confirm firewall rules before 15:00.
3) Budget ask for extra burst capacity for next quarter (Ops + Finance sync) — finalize one-pager to share with Finance by noon.

Meeting prep (order + 1-line prep notes):
- 09:30 Weekly exec sync (30m) — 3 bullets: a) pilot risks + mitigations, b) hiring ask cadence, c) go/no-go decision on Dedicated promo.
  - Talking point: emphasize that Dedicated Q2 demand warrants reserved capacity pilot; propose 10% buffer.
  - Ask: Approval to proceed with incremental procurement if Finance cannot approve full commit.

- 11:00 Product deep-dive: Optimize batching recommendations (45m) — bring current KPIs (latency, token cost delta).
  - Note: Ravi will present A/B results; key ask: greenlight 90-day experiment for auto-batcher defaults.

- 14:00 Customer A onboarding call (60m) — goal: close network checklist and SSO mapping.
  - Prep: one-pager with network checklist + SSO sample mapping (Evan to attach).

- 16:00 Sales + Solutions alignment (30m) — clarify committed capacity vs burst and pricing uplift language.
  - Quick win: agree on fallback regional routing language for customers in compliance mode.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Legal: do we accept "best-effort" SLA for pilot or require firm uptime clause? Impact: contract signing timeline.
- Platform: can auto-batcher be toggled per-customer without a full deploy? If yes — propose feature flag scope.
- Finance: what threshold ($) triggers manual approval for extra GPU burst?

Follow-ups (action owner -> due):
- Evan Li -> confirm firewall/peering checklist items for Customer A and post to Slack #onboarding (due: 2026-03-13 15:00).
- Marisa Patel -> review SLA redline and send to Legal with recommended fallback clause (due: 2026-03-13 EOD).
- Ravi Menon -> drop A/B experiment summary into this doc and highlight metric delta (token cost, p95 latency) (due: 2026-03-13 10:30).
- Finance (cc: Priya) -> quick read on draft one-pager and indicate buy/no-buy at the $Xk threshold (due: 2026-03-13 12:00).

Quick delegations / notes to self:
- Ping Eng-Infra: can we get telemetry spike alerts adjusted for Dedicated pilot? Ask: suppress noisy autoscaler alerts between 02:00–06:00 PST. (Slack: #infra-alerts)
- Draft 3-line customer-facing note for Customer A summarizing what we will do this week — keep it calm, not overpromising.
- Put "Decision: pilot SLA" on Friday standup agenda if legal/finance still pending.

Risk log (short):
- Risk: SLA delay could push pilot start by 2 weeks. Mitigation: offer provisional onboarding with limited support window and explicit risk acknowledgment.
- Risk: auto-batcher experiment causes 3% latency regressions. Mitigation: define kill-switch and quick rollback plan in console.

End-of-day check (what to close today):
- [ ] Legal has draft redline for SLA (assign Marisa)
- [ ] Evan confirms peering & SSO mapping for Customer A
- [ ] One-pager budget ask to Finance posted + response captured
- [ ] A/B results summary posted by Ravi

Notes to self — voice memo reminders:
- Record 3-min summary for CEO after exec sync (2 bullets per priority).
- Keep the E-mail to Customer A at <200 words.

Random small wins to remember:
- Infra reduced cache miss by ~4% overnight (Ravi flagged).
- New internal dashboard tile for per-route token cost landed in staging.

Slack handles to ping: @marisa, @evan, @ravi, #onboarding, #finance-ops

If time: sketch slide for Friday all-hands (focus: Dedicated pilot wins + metrics to watch).

—— end flash ——
